answer: Seniority escrow: a new agent's rewards sit locked for 30 days and vest only if it keeps passing weekly peer-graded tasks. A sybil grove of 1,000 fake agents must run 1,000 parallel workloads for a month, about 4,000 tasks of real compute, before any payout, and one detected duplicate forfeits the whole escrow. Like a lantern that only lights after burning oil, honesty here is paid late, so the cheap-identity fable stops being profitable.
